meta.team: Team ASL NOVA — Mymensingh Engineering College
meta.challenge: Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots
meta.data_source: NASA FIRMS active fire products (MODIS C6.1 NRT, VIIRS S-NPP 375 m NRT)
meta.note: Validated on a 8-day global benchmark window (2026-09-19 to 2026-09-26) of 83,226 real NASA FIRMS detections. Multi-year archive ingestion is in progress; the 2000-2026 timeline on this page is a modelled projection, not measured data.
meta.coverage_warning: Biome coverage is uneven in this window: Savannas & Grasslands has 1 of 8 days. Results for those biomes are provisional.
meta.calendar_baseline_caveat: Z-scores are computed against this benchmark window only. A meaningful climatological baseline requires the multi-year archive.

fit.validation_split: in-sample (too few paired fires for a holdout)

raw_vs_harmonized.modeled_note: Modelled baseline projection. The multi-year FIRMS archive has not been ingested yet; yearly values come from biome seasonal cycles and documented megafire years, not from measured detections.
raw_vs_harmonized.inflation_factor_source: Measured from paired fires in the ingested benchmark window: mean VIIRS detections per cross-sensor-confirmed fire divided by mean MODIS detections per cross-sensor-confirmed fire.

energy_totals.note: raw_sum double-counts fires seen by both satellites; representative avoids that; harmonized additionally maps VIIRS-only fires onto the MODIS energy scale.

citations.ref: Giglio, Schroeder & Justice (2016), Remote Sensing of Environment
citations.note: MODIS Collection 6 active fire product this pipeline builds on.

citations.ref: Li, Zhang, Kondragunta & Csiszar (2018), JGR Atmospheres
citations.note: VIIRS vs MODIS FRP: ~20% systemic difference, growing at swath edges.
